messages:
maria_eng: Heads up — saw a regression in regional prefix cache hit-rate in APAC after the recent kernel selection + batching rollout. Small prompts hit-rate dropped sharply.

kevin_perf: saw the graph. APAC small-prefix hit went from ~88% -> ~52% over the last 6h. EU/US stable.

maria_eng: I pulled logs and there are lots of near-duplicate prefixes that don't match across replicas. Looks like key normalization changed.

sam_runtime: Confirmed with a dump. Example mismatch: local key vs replica key differ by an extra field. Snippet:
```
kv_key: prefix|model:gpt-4r|seq:128|hash:0xabc123
kv_key_replica: prefix|model:gpt-4r|seq:128|hash:0xabc123|inst:az1-rt-02
```

eva_sre: Did we roll different runtime hashes in regions? Could be a canary-only change.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: runtime-v2.14 rolled to apac (canary) at 1967999000

kevin_perf: Profiling the keygen path shows we accidentally appended runtime_instance_id for low-batch kernel path to avoid collision. That breaks replication key equality.

sam_runtime: That explains it. We introduced a salt (instance_id) in the key for an optimization path — replication expects stable keys across instances. Bug.

maria_eng: Mitigations to consider (ranked):
- Hotfix: remove instance_id from key gen (quick rollback)
- Routing: route small-prefix APAC traffic to EU warm pool for 4h as a stopgap
- Passive prefetch: replicate top-50k prefixes to APAC proactively
- Adjust TTLs so warm cache persists through the window
Thoughts?

eva_sre: :thumbsup: Routing tweak fastest. Latency cost estimated ~+20ms for APAC->EU on small prompts. Is that acceptable?

kevin_perf: Ran a sim: routing 10% small traffic -> eu-warm recovers hit-rate to ~85% with token-cost delta +0.6%. Good short-term tradeoff.

maria_eng: I'll open a PR for the key-normalization hotfix and a canary rollback. Sam — can you add a routing policy: `route_policy: prefer_warm(eu,apac) if prompt_tokens < 120` ?

sam_runtime: On it. Patch in staging: https://git.internal/redwood/policies/PR-3245
I'll add a metric for cross-region key parity and an alert on key-drift > 1%.

maria_eng: Also adding tests: deterministic normalization unit test + e2e that compares KV keys across regions before merge. Add to perf gate.

kevin_perf: Postmortem TODOs: 1) remove instance_id salt 2) cross-region key parity tests 3) routing fallback for cold-region mitigation 4) add kernel-selection audit to ensure no hidden salts in keygen

maria_eng: I'll coordinate rollback if PR merges. tagging oncall @eva_sre for SLO watch.

eva_sre: I'll monitor SLOs and approve the routing change once sam pushes. If we need escalation, ping #incidents.

ops-bot: Note: created incident stub for investigation: INC-2026 (auto)

maria_eng: Thanks all — will update once PR + routing are live.
